text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We're training during summer camp,<n>and Biwa
Hayahide is running under<n>the blistering sun.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... There... I've finished tenbeach dashes. What's next on thelist?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No. I made sure to drink plenty of<n>water before we
started.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Let's increase the intensity of my<n>exercises a little.
Can you make sure<n>to record my numbers
accurately?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I want to determine the extent of my<n>endurance and
how much more I can<n>improve.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She seems really serious. What<n>should we move
on to next?
choice_data_list: All right, time to enter aerobic hell!
All right, time to enter aerobic hell!
Let's add a forty-kilometer marathon to your plate.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She seems really serious. What<n>should we move
on to next?
choice_data_list: All right, time to enter aerobic hell!
All right, time to enter aerobic hell!
Let's add a forty-kilometer marathon to your plate.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Uh, aerobic hell?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I connect speakers to my phone and<n>start playing
some music.

text_block_list.name: Speakers
text_block_list.text:
Hi, everyone! ♪ I'm Buff Chick, and<n>welcome to a
Happy Hell of an<n>Aerobics workout! Now, lift that
leg<n>up—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Speakers
text_block_list.text:
Okay, warm-up's over! ♪ How ya<n>feelin'? Now it's
time to get that<n>upper body burning! ♪

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
B-but I've been doing this for an hour<n>already...
Agh... That was... just the<n>warm-up?!

text_block_list.name: Speakers
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! Don't forget to SMILE!<n>Now let's work
those glutes! Let me<n>see you flex! And flex! One
more time<n>now! ♪

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Urrgghhh! Who came up with this<n>torture?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
A marathon... That would certainly<n>help train all my
muscle groups, and<n>not just the ones I need for
sprinting...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But forty kilometers is practically a full<n>marathon. If I
start running now...<n>Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No, I'll do it. I'm the one who asked<n>for harder
training. If I can't handle<n>this, then I should just
give up on my<n>dreams right now.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'll show you that I can push through<n>my limits.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide starts her<n>forty-kilometer marathon.
This will be<n>a good test of her overall condition.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Quite some time later...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe it myself! My baseline<n>endurance
has really improved!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: All that training since the Derby has<n>really paid off!
choice_data_list: It sure has! You've been working so hard.
It sure has! You've been working so hard.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, no need to lay it on so thick.<n>The only reason
I performed poorly<n>before was because I lacked the
conviction to push myself.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Maybe all of this time, I've just been<n>ignoring the
fact that I could choose to<n>step beyond my
self-imposed limits.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The day I was overtaken and pushed<n>myself too
hard to catch up, leading to<n>my injury... Ever since
then, I've<n>been playing it safe.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But I've moved on to the next stage!<n>I have infinite
possibilities before me,<n>and the world is mine!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I hope I didn't sound too conceited<n>just now.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe... That's good to hear.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now all I have to do is put in a good<n>showing at the
Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I listen to Biwa Hayahide's promises<n>to herself as
we leave the<n>sunset-bathed beach.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Training starts at 8 a.m. tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(I'm improving faster than I<n>previously calculated.
Now all I have<n>to do is wait to test myself in a race!)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: (Still, I can't help thinking...)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: DEEERRRBYYYYY!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(I guess they're still obsessed with<n>the Satsuki Sho
and the Japanese<n>Derby...)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Well, I think I'll have some warm<n>milk, and—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Tomorrow. 10 o'clock. Race me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you'd better bring it 'cause<n>I'm gonna do the
same, and I'm<n>gonna beat you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hmph. We'll see about that.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Right now, you're my biggest threat.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to beat both of you at the<n>Kikuka Sho...
and claim first place on<n>the podium.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, how odd. There's nothing<n>strange with what
Taishin is saying...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But my heart is beating so fast. I<n>wonder why I feel
like this?
